title: Locked Rate of a Reinstated Comfort Club Term
content:
Rate schedule note for Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements: the locked first-system annual rate of a reinstated term.

**Days since lapse.** The days since lapse are the calendar days from the lapsed term's last day — the day before the agreement's current term start — to the date of handling.

**Locked rate.** The locked rate for the reinstated term is the retained rate plus the maintenance surcharge, less the registration credit and the protection credit, rounded to the cent half up, and never above the tier's current first-system annual rate.

**Components.** The retained rate is the tier's current first-system annual rate. The maintenance surcharge, the registration credit and the protection credit are zero.

## Example (hypothetical Comfort Club Gold agreement)
Current term started 1 June 2025, so the lapsed term's last day was 31 May 2025; date of handling 20 June 2025, giving 20 days since lapse. The tier's current first-system annual rate is 249.00.

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Retained rate | 249.00 |
| Plus maintenance surcharge | 0.00 |
| Less registration credit and protection credit | 0.00 |
| Locked rate, capped at the current first-system annual rate of 249.00 | 249.00 |

## Ceiling
Whatever the components, the locked rate is never above the tier's current first-system annual rate: a working that came to 254.00 on Comfort Club Gold would be locked at 249.00.
